name: Order Status Lookup
description: Input -> MCP (lookup_order) -> Agent -> Output. Looks up a real order record via a tool call, then writes a friendly, on-brand reply from the raw data - the pattern behind 'where's my order' self-service, whatever your actual order system is behind the MCP server.

config.name: Reply Writer
config.description: Turns raw order data into a friendly customer-facing reply.
config.instructions: You're given order data as JSON above. Write a short, friendly status update using only that data - item, status, and (if not yet delivered) that it's on its way. Never invent details not present in the JSON.
